evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Data Excellence: Implement solutions to improve data quality, documentation, and versioning.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Data quality/documentation/versioning language balances against 'high-traffic environments' optimization and squad-based feature-delivery framing, giving mixed weight to both.
evidence.domain_risk: Monitor and forecast Revenue (CA), ARR, MRR, Margin, and LTV across our ecosystem of Users, Creators, Ambassadors.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors affect business/financial metrics (revenue, margin) at a creator-platform company, a real but non-regulatory consequence without financial-reporting/audit language, placing this at moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Product; Growth; Finance; Product Manager; back-end team
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A named 'Data Team' with a Lead Data role and an existing squad-based delivery structure with Analytics/ML Engineers already integrated indicates a growing but already-established data function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design and implement efficient, robust data models from a wide variety of sources to serve as our 'Single Source of Truth'.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise technical scope (tracking plan, reverse ETL, cohort analysis by acquisition channel/device/geography, scoring models) and specific tools (DBT, Redshift/Spectrum, Airbyte/Rudderstack, Dagster), showing exactly what the role does day to day.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: You will empower over 50 employees across Product, Growth, and Finance teams by making data accessible and reliable.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role serves Product, Growth, and Finance functions roughly equally as named stakeholders alongside internal data-platform ownership, giving mixed weight across multiple orientations.
evidence.autonomy_level: You will steer our strategic roadmap by overseeing a comprehensive range of metrics
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role combines strategic roadmap ownership and data-platform-foundation building (strategic) with responding to defined squad/stakeholder requests and specific KPI monitoring (execution), making this mixed.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tooling or AI-adjacent responsibility is mentioned anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Data Excellence: Implement solutions to improve data quality, documentation, and versioning.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality and versioning are framed as an owned responsibility with an explicit ownership verb (implement), not just a tool in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed entirely in growth, ownership, and capability terms (steer the roadmap, build the Single Source of Truth) with no risk, compliance, or reliability register present.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Help build the foundations of our data platform in close collaboration with the Lead Data
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The JD mixes new-build language (build the foundations, design and implement data models) with existing-metric-monitoring and process-improvement language, making this mixed.
evidence.work_arrangement: 1 remote working day per week for a better Work-Life Balance.
